newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Congress stakes claim to form government.
newsitem.headline: India's Congress stakes claim to form government.

text.p: India's Congress party on Monday formally staked its claim to form a new government, a party official told Reuters.

"My understanding is that a formal claim has been made," the official, who did not wish to be identified, told Reuters. "I cannot say if the Congress president went personally to meet the President or if a letter was sent to him."
The Congress party was expected to make a formal statement at 4:00 p.m. (1030 GMT), the official said.
Congress withdrew its support for Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda's ruling coalition on Sunday and served notice it would attempt to form a new government.
Earlier on Monday Deve Gowda was quoted as saying he would not resign despite the loss of the Congress party's support in parliament.

"There is no question of my resignation or suggesting dissolution of the (lower) house," the Press Trust of India (PTI) quoted Deve Gowda as telling reporters in the capital. "The trial of strength will be held on the floor of the house."
